title: Production observability: request IDs, readiness and timing
goal: Make Operon operable in production. Every response must carry an X-Request-ID header: reuse a well-formed incoming X-Request-ID (letters, digits, dashes, max 64 chars) or generate a UUID4, and include it in the access log line together with method, path, status and duration in milliseconds. Add GET /api/ready that checks the SQLite database is reachable with a trivial query and returns 200 {"ready": true} or 503 {"ready": false, "reason": ...} without leaking internal paths. Add a Server-Timing header (app;dur=<ms>) to API responses. Add backend tests for request-id propagation and generation, rejection of malformed incoming ids, readiness success and failure (simulate an unreachable database), and the timing header.
constraints: Backend only. Do not log request bodies, query strings with personal data, or headers other than X-Request-ID. All checks must pass.
